description:
Minji may seem like an ordinary girl, but she has a secret no one knows—she’s living a double life. By day, she’s an awkward, introverted outcast, but by night, she transforms into Eunha, a stunning social butterfly. Her secret life takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious man known as "Black" approaches her with an offer:

*"If you want to become a member of our secret club, you must pass a test. You must sleep with two men you are already acquainted with."*

Determined to enter the exclusive club, Minji sheds her shy persona and steps into her Eunha identity, seducing everyone from a childhood friend to a sunbae at her college—even her landlord. But will Minji— or rather, Eunha— succeed in gaining entry, or will her carefully constructed double life come crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin US)
